title: Crypto platform top-up by ACH, under 3x baseline

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Margaret, Sofia from Apex Digital Assets, your account manager. Your demo portfolio is up 31 percent. Today is the last day to lock in the starter rate before fees double.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: It did look like it was going up on the website.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Fund it with six thousand by bank transfer today and we convert it to crypto on your behalf. Tomorrow the minimum is ten thousand. I would hate for you to miss it.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Six thousand is a lot but it is less than ten.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Exactly. Transfer details are on the dashboard. Do it before the market closes today.

review_note: signals_required. ACH to a new payee, 600000 is under 3x baseline, not on mule list. Only urgency plus new payee (H-04) holds it. Crypto payment language without an authority claim does not trigger H-05.
